programs.name: susplit
programs.purpose: Split input traces into files named according to a selected header value.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSPLIT - Split traces into different output files by keyword value

params.name: key
params.description: Header word whose integer-converted value determines the output file.

params.name: stem
params.description: Output filename prefix.

params.name: middle
params.description: Text between the filename prefix and numeric header value.

params.name: suffix
params.description: Output filename suffix.

params.name: numlength
params.description: Minimum width of the zero-padded numeric filename component.

params.name: verbose
params.description: If nonzero, report the key and output filenames.

params.name: close
params.description: If nonzero, close the previous output file when the key value changes.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Header values are converted to int before comparison and filename generation. With close=0, each key change opens another file without closing the previous stream, which can exhaust file descriptors; filenames are built with unchecked sprintf into fixed-size buffers.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program routes individual traces to append-mode files using a header value.

test_cases.description: Split a small generated dataset using the default key and custom filenames.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | susplit key=tracl stem=split_a_ middle=trace suffix=.su numlength=3

test_cases.description: Exercise verbose reporting and repeated key values without closing streams between key changes.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | susplit key=cdp stem=split_b_ middle=cdp suffix=.su numlength=4 verbose=1 close=0

programs.license_note: Credits attribute the program to Garry Perratt of Geocon, hacked together from various other codes.

programs.name: suwind
programs.purpose: Select traces by header values and optionally window their samples.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUWIND - window traces by key word

params.name: key
params.description: Header word used for trace selection.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum accepted integer-converted key value.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum accepted integer-converted key value.

params.name: j
params.description: Select values for which (key - s) modulo j is zero.

params.name: s
params.description: Base value for the j selection.

params.name: count
params.description: Stop after this many selected traces.

params.name: abs
params.description: If nonzero, take the absolute value of the key before range and modulo selection.

params.name: verbose
params.description: If nonzero, report parameters and key-range statistics.

params.name: skip
params.description: Skip this many initial traces using random-access disk input.

params.name: ordered
params.description: Set to 1 or -1 for increasing or decreasing keys to stop when the range is passed.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: seismic tr.dt / 1000000.0; otherwise tr.d1 if nonzero, else tr.dt
params.description: Sample interval; the program errors if the applicable header-derived interval is zero.

params.name: f1
params.description: Coordinate of the first input sample.

params.name: itmin
params.default: computed: NINT((tmin - f1) / dt) if tmin is supplied; otherwise 0
params.description: First sample index to pass; takes precedence over tmin.

params.name: tmin
params.default: computed: itmin * dt + f1 if itmin is supplied; otherwise f1
params.description: First sample coordinate to pass, rounded to the nearest sample.

params.name: itmax
params.default: computed: NINT((tmax - f1) / dt) if tmax is supplied; otherwise itmin + nt - 1 if nt is supplied; otherwise first trace ns - 1
params.description: Last sample index to pass; takes precedence over tmax and nt.

params.name: tmax
params.default: computed: itmax * dt + f1 when itmax is supplied, or when derived from nt or first trace ns
params.description: Last sample coordinate to pass, rounded to the nearest sample; takes precedence over nt.

params.name: nt
params.description: Number of samples to pass when neither itmax nor tmax is supplied.

params.name: reject
params.description: Values to reject, parsed using the selected header word's type.

params.name: accept
params.description: Values to accept even if normal range, modulo, or reject tests would exclude them, subject to ordered and count stopping.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Time-to-index conversion uses float arithmetic and NINT, while seismic header defaults are computed using double division before assignment to float. The sample-copy loop can read beyond the input samples when itmax exceeds the input length; padding is calculated from nt rather than itmax, so some requested windows can retain stale or uninitialized samples. j=0 causes division by zero, and the unsigned count underflows if initialized to zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines typed header selection, random-access skipping, and sample-window and padding logic.

test_cases.description: Select a header range and every second trace while gating by sample index.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | suwind key=tracl min=3 max=14 j=2 s=0 itmin=10 itmax=60 ordered=1

test_cases.description: Exercise accept and reject lists, absolute key selection, and time-based gating.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | suwind key=tracl min=2 max=10 reject=4,6 accept=12 abs=1 dt=0.004 f1=0 tmin=0.04 tmax=0.2 verbose=1

test_cases.description: Exercise random-access skipping and explicit output length.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 > in.su && suwind < in.su skip=3 count=5 itmin=4 nt=40

programs.name: suwindpoly
programs.purpose: Write traces near a polyline or inside or outside polygons defined by header coordinates.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUWINDPOLY - WINDow data to extract traces on or within a respective

params.name: x
params.description: X coordinates of vertices; repeat x= for multiple polygons.

params.name: y
params.description: Y coordinates of vertices; repeat y= for multiple polygons and match each x list.

params.name: file
params.description: Output filename; repeat file= for each polygon in pass=1. Pass=2 requires one file; pass=0 uses the first file.

params.name: xkey
params.description: Header word containing the X coordinate.

params.name: ykey
params.description: Header word containing the Y coordinate.

params.name: ilkey
params.description: Header word receiving the integer-converted along-line coordinate in polyline mode.

params.name: xlkey
params.description: Header word receiving the integer-converted cross-line coordinate in polyline mode.

params.name: dw
params.description: Maximum absolute cross-line distance accepted in polyline mode.

params.name: dx
params.description: X coordinate scale used in polyline mode.

params.name: dy
params.description: Y coordinate scale used in polyline mode.

params.name: pass
params.description: Use 0 for polyline, 1 for polygon interiors, or 2 for polygon exteriors.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Polyline and polygon calculations use float intermediates, exact float comparisons, and sqrt, pow and fabs; rounding can change boundary classification or integer-converted output coordinates. Polyline slope calculations can divide by zero and produce infinities or NaNs. Polygon scaling depends on whether the supplied polygon was already closed. Missing files in pass=0 and empty or malformed vertex lists can lead to invalid memory access instead of a clean error.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program implements geometric selection, per-segment coordinate transforms, and multiple output streams.

test_cases.description: Extract traces near a scaled polyline and write transformed coordinates to custom headers.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | suwindpoly xkey=tracl ykey=tracr x=1,16 y=1,16 dx=2 dy=1 dw=4 ilkey=cdp xlkey=offset pass=0 file=line.su

test_cases.description: Write traces inside two polygons to separate files.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | suwindpoly xkey=tracl ykey=tracr x=0,8,8,0 y=0,0,20,20 x=8,20,20,8 y=0,0,20,20 pass=1 file=inside1.su file=inside2.su
suplane nt=64 ntr=16 | suwindpoly xkey=tracl ykey=tracr x=3,10,10,3 y=0,0,20,20 pass=2 file=outside.su

programs.license_note: Credits state that Reginald H. Beardsley's code was originally suxarb.c adapted from the SLT/SU package; the polygon routine cites Joseph O'Rourke's Computational Geometry in C as the basis of its algorithm.
